description: Military Engineer Services (MES), Ministry of Defence, invites applications from Balochistan-domicile candidates for 54 non-gazetted and RTE staff posts, BPS-01 to BPS-11, across 18 titles. This is a Balochistan-quota advertisement (Jang, 8 Nov 2026, Engineer-in-Chief Branch, GHQ Rawalpindi). Verified 11 Nov 2026: deadline 14 Nov 2026 and the MES listings (Labourer 14, Pipe Fitter/Plumber 4, Motor Pump Attendant 4, Carpenter 2, Polisher 1) were live on the official National Job Portal homepage. Correction to the draft brief: the official advertisement directs applicants to apply online via the National Job Portal (njp.gov.pk), not only via jobs.mes.gov.pk. Both portals are listed here — check the ad on NJP before applying. Recruitment for BPS-01 to BPS-16 is by walk-in interview, with no written/entry test, per the advertisement.
education: Primary to DAE (Civil / Electrical / Mechanical) and Matric plus trade certificate, post-wise
howToApply: Apply online only through the National Job Portal at njp.gov.pk before 14 Nov 2026, as directed in the official advertisement. Also check the MES recruitment portal jobs.mes.gov.pk. No hard copy, no agent. Shortlisted candidates are called for walk-in interviews (CMES (Army) Quetta, per the ad).
organization: Military Engineer Services (MES), Ministry of Defence
requirements: 18 titles, 54 posts: Sub Engineer (B&R) BPS-11 — 4; Sub Engineer (E&M) BPS-11 — 1; Lower Division Clerk BPS-11 — 7; Storeman BPS-07 — 1; Junior Draftsman / Junior CAD Designer BPS-07 — 4; Daftry BPS-02 — 2; Fitter Mechanic BPS-06 — 1; Switch Board Attendant BPS-06 — 1; Sui Gas Fitter BPS-06 — 1; Welder BPS-06 — 1; Complaint Receiver BPS-05 — 1; Carpenter BPS-04 — 2; Motor Pump Attendant BPS-04 — 4; Painter BPS-04 — 2; Pipe Fitter / Plumber BPS-04 — 4; Polisher BPS-04 — 1; Labourer BPS-01 — 14; Sanitary Worker BPS-01 — 3. salary: BPS-01 to BPS-11, as per government pay scales

description: Federal Public Service Commission Consolidated Advertisement No. 4/2026 (Phase-4/2026), dated 6 Nov 2026: 48 cases, BS-16 to BS-20, in federal ministries and departments. Headline case: 160 Assistant Audit Officer (BS-17) posts, Office of the Auditor General of Pakistan, Case F.4-195/2026-R. Written screening test (MCQs) tentatively from 2 Jan 2027. education: Post-wise: Second Class / Grade C Master's or Bachelor's, MBBS, BE, or equivalent, per case
howToApply: Apply online only at fpsc.gov.pk (General Recruitment — Apply Online) before Mon 23 Nov 2026. Select your case number, generate the PSID and pay the fee via 1-Link before the closing date. No hard copy required.

description: The Staff Welfare Organization, under the Establishment Division, is hiring for seven posts in Quetta — and every one of them is reserved for Balochistan-domicile candidates. There is one Instructor post for someone with shorthand and typing speed, two Driver posts, and three Chowkidar and one Farash post for primary-pass applicants. It is a small, straightforward advertisement: apply online through the National Job Portal, then turn up for a walk-in interview in Quetta on 26 or 27 November. No written test, no fee, and no direct applications to the organisation. Verification note: the ad itself gives the deadline only as 15 days from its 4 November publication, which works out to 19 November; one listing gives 17 November instead, so check the date on NJP before you apply.
experience: Instructor: 3 years' experience as a typist. Driver: valid driving licence.
howToApply: Apply online only through the National Job Portal at njp.gov.pk within 15 days of the advertisement's publication (by 19 Nov 2026). No direct applications to the organisation will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates are called for walk-in interviews in Quetta — Instructor and Driver on 26 Nov 2026, Chowkidar and Farash on 27 Nov 2026. No TA/DA.
requirements: 4 titles, 7 posts: Instructor BPS-11 — 1 (Intermediate with shorthand and typing speed of 80/30 wpm, 3 years' experience as a typist); Driver BPS-04 — 2 (Primary pass, valid driving licence, well versed in traffic rules); Chowkidar BPS-01 — 3 (Primary pass); Farash BPS-01 — 1 (Primary pass). Age 18-25 years for Instructor, Chowkidar and Farash, and 18-30 years for Driver, plus age relaxation per government rules. Balochistan domicile required.
salary: BPS-01 to BPS-11, as per government pay scales
source: Official advertisement PID(I) 4067/26, Staff Welfare Organization, Establishment Division, published in The Express Tribune 4 Nov 2026, via National Job Portal njp.gov.pk. description: The Office of the Wafaqi Mohtasib — the Federal Ombudsman — has one opening at its Regional Office in Quetta, for a Chowkidar on the regular BPS-01 scale. It is a primary-pass post, and it sits under the 6% Balochistan quota, so applicants need a Balochistan domicile or a valid residence certificate. There is no written test: shortlisted candidates are called for a walk-in interview, and you take your original documents and domicile certificate with you. Apply online through the National Job Portal before 23 November. Verification note: the NJP listing itself gives two different wordings for the age limit — its description says 18 to 35 including relaxations, while its overview box says maximum 30 with federal relaxation rules — so check your eligibility on the listing itself before applying. One aggregator also gives the last date as 24 November; the NJP listing's own figure, 23 November, is used here.
